axes.B: Remove historical full SDL-equivalence grouping; comment/fixture scope does not claim media decode or browser autoplay permission.
axes.C: Each suite owns prototype spies and closes the actual player via ended before timers and ports are restored.
axes.D: Move499/500ms positive timing here; the negative/custom-key contracts catch erroneous queued cleanup, rather than duplicate the same input.
axes.E: Keep original oracles; two real source mutants passed old tests and fail current exact business assertions. Repeated ended also observes sole pause.
axes.F: Playback file and activeVideo guard name the actual host object without nullable casts.
axes.G: No discarded cases; nine playback contracts separated from four volume contracts.
axes.H: Actual player executes with only media IO/time controlled; no game state or renderer mock.

axes.A: Four original initial/live/clamp/disposed-element volume contracts retain literal independent expected values.
axes.B: Explain current element ownership rather than browser sound quality.
axes.C: Ended cleanup precedes restoring spies; volume is reset so later suites do not borrow prior settings.
axes.D: Volume configuration shares module state with playback but has distinct setter ownership, so has a dedicated spec.
axes.E: All four callbacks preserve input values and expected volumes; only real element narrowing and cleanup improve.
axes.F: volume path identifies the tool-slider port; local activeVideo requires the created element.
axes.G: No generic media fixture or modes added; four distinct failure modes retained.
axes.H: HTMLMediaElement.volume is observed on the actual element; audio output is outside this host evidence.

axes.A: Five exact previous autoplay/retry/warm-up callbacks remain; source fully read against current real callers.
axes.B: Replace author/zero-coverage and stale line header with controlled retry and warm-up scope.
axes.C: Each pending play is explicitly settled, ended removes actual overlay/listener before host mocks restore.
axes.D: First-only deferred and multi-attempt controls differ in lifetime; do not force a universal shared Promise registry.
axes.E: Independent click/DOM/play-target and exact warning arrays retained; no invocation count substitutes for visible overlay state.
axes.F: Autoplay filename names browser-refusal fallback rather than contributor or batch.
axes.G: No new case/fixture modes, duplicated lifecycle case or retired compatibility path.
axes.H: Only media transport is controlled; real rejection/click/end and final cleanup run. No real-browser policy acceptance claimed.

axes.A: Five real late-play,skip-window,next-owner and warm-up completions retain original public sequence.
axes.B: Header narrows evidence; stale main.ts line reference replaced with named click caller. Expected diagnostics now explicitly stated.
axes.C: Owned pending registry settles after ended and before port restore; stale timers cannot take the next element.
axes.D: Two registry-backed deferred patterns are not merged with the autoplay suite whose ownership differs.
axes.E: All original oracles retained; three previously silent warn spies now assert sole exact original warning message.
axes.F: Existing async-lifecycle name already states responsibility; not a new historical subject.
axes.G: No added lifecycle test or retired old assertion; six total callback repairs across this module are explicit.
